Please review the proposed scope for the Russian-language website. The English version is not included. The scope is awaiting your approval; pricing is set out in the attached proposal.

Please confirm whether you agree with this scope, or let us know what needs clarification or adjustment. You may also decline the proposed scope. This request is for agreement on scope only; confirmation does not place an order.
